text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I will run the Takamatsunomiya Kinen as a 
new me. A me who has undergone new 
training tailored to my growing body.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Racing against Bakushin O-san, Zephyr-san, 
and all those other cool older girls is 
definitely scary. Even so...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Me too! Trainer told me I was "cool." I 
know I can bloom into a flower unlike any 
before!
